faq.q: Is my text sent to a server?

faq.a: Words are sequences of characters separated by whitespace. Hyphenated compounds count as one word, matching the convention used by most word processors.
Reading time assumes an average adult reading speed of 200 words per minute and is rounded up to the nearest minute.

whenNotToUse: Don't rely on it where an exact official count matters — hyphenated words, numbers and footnote text are counted differently by some style guides and word processors.
If a document must keep its formatting (tables, footnotes, tracked changes), count it in the original editor instead.
